task.pr_title: Save detection inference logs to file

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
logger arg needs a default value None, the default behavior should be using logger from `logger = get_logger()`.

otherwise, it will break this: https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR/blob/1569cfb430dee06b23413b7b0a6d99dc8c84ab70/tools/infer/predict_system.py#L51

evidence.attached_diff_hunk:
